description: Variation of Condition 5 (Opening hours) to change opening hours to 11:00 - 23:00 Monday to Wednesday, 11:00 - 00:30 Thursday to Saturday and 11:00 - 23:00 Sundays of planning permission 00607/55/P5 dated 10/01/2002 for the change of use from B1 (office) to A3 (restaurant) and B1 (office).
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of the original permission 00607/55/P5 dated 10 January 2002

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted ((PA/01 and PA/02 received 18/09/2002. Location Plan Rev A; Planning, Design and Access Statement; Noise Impact Assessment dated 30 June 2022. Received: 13 July 2022. Assessment of Mitigation Measures report dated 11 October 2022. Received: 12 October 2022) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The premises shall be used for restaurant and offices and for no other purpose (including any other purpose in Class E of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987 (as amended), or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification).
Condition : 4 - No additional floorspace shall be formed within the buildings hereby permitted by means of internal horizontal division without prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The restaurant use hereby permitted shall not be open to customers outside the following times: 11am to 11pm Monday to Wednesday, 11am to 00.30 Thursday to Saturday and 11am to 11pm on Sunday.
Condition : 6 - No deliveries shall be taken at or despatched from the site outside the hours of 9am to 7pm

Condition : 7 - The use hereby permitted shall not be begun until details of the arrangements for storing of refuse or waste have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  The arrangements for storing of refuse or waste shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given and shall be completed before any part of the accommodation hereby permitted is occupied.

Condition : 8 - The use hereby permitted for restaurant and office purposes shall not be begun until full particulars and details of a scheme to insulate the premises against the transmission of airborne and impact sound has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority and the development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given.

Condition : 9 - The use shall not commence until a scheme for control of fumes and odours including details of sound attenuation for any necessary plant has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority in writing.

Condition : 10 - The use shall not commence until a scheme for the ventilation of the premises of an appropriate outlet level, including details of sound attenuation for any necessary plant and the standard or dilution expected has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 11 - Before the development hereby permitted is commenced a scheme indicating the provision to be made for disabled people to gain access to the restaurant and offices shall have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  The agreed scheme shall be implemented before the development hereby permitted is brought into use.

Condition : 12 - All live and amplified music and voice shall be played through a sound limiting device, this device must be set at a level which does not exceed 75dB, LAeq(15min) on the ground floor and 72dB, LAeq(15min) on the first floor, prior to the use of the extended hours requested in this application.
Condition : 13 - No live or amplified music or voice will be played on site between the hours of 23.00 and 11.00 hours Monday to Sunday
